feature_configuration.word_ngrams: 1-2, min_df=2, max_features=60000, used only in word+character model

validation_strategy.timestamp_limitation: source has no per-URL observation time

test_strategy: Untouched registrable-domain-disjoint partition; selected model and threshold were fixed before final test scoring.

selected_thresholds.selection_rule: Highest phishing recall subject to UCI validation FPR <= 2% and hard-negative validation FPR <= 10%; ties prefer lower hard-negative FPR, then PR-AUC and F1. Both final test partitions are excluded from selection.
selected_thresholds.structural_severity_guard: MALICIOUS requires two independent structural signals; otherwise high probability remains SUSPICIOUS.

hard_negative_metrics.note: Fresh held-out external official URLs on registrable roots absent from UCI and the earlier hard-negative set; descriptive only and not used for fit or threshold/model selection.

baseline_on_same_final_test.note: Legacy artifact scored with its previously selected threshold on v4's final rows. The old artifact may have seen some UCI rows/domains during its original fit, so its UCI test metrics are retrospective, not a fresh holdout. External challenge domains are absent from UCI and the prior hard-negative list.

latency_and_size.latency_includes: URL feature extraction and single-row model prediction
